body:
Android client of the ledger design (T-239): implement sections 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 of the design of
record, matching the WEB implementation exactly in layout, wording and behaviour. The web work
is already on main (T-245) together with the shared case table and ALL new strings (both
clients' catalogs): use the existing new resource names; do not re-translate. The colours
ticket (T-241) is also on main: use its balanceColor/signedMoney.

* Expense.kt `type`; ExpenseMath.kt type-aware (`balancesFor` with settled, `spentTotals`,
  `entryEffectCents`, `settle` unchanged) driven by the shared case table; the seeded property
  test; DTO/serialization (absent type = expense, unknown/absent keys ignored as before).
* ExpenseFormViewModel + ExpenseDialog (segmented type control, per-type labels, transfer
  From/To pickers, switching rules, validation, blank-title defaults), ExpenseListScreen rows
  and header, BalancesScreen, Overview card net total, list-kind naming (Ledger), tab labels,
  "Add entry", "Net spent". "Reimburse" creates a Transfer.
* Remove any Android string resource made obsolete by this (the web agent kept them so Android
  kept compiling), keep lint clean; android/README.md wherever it describes expense lists.
* Tests: ExpenseMath cases + property test, the view-model for every type (payloads incl.
  transfer single maps, type switching rules, validation, blank-title defaults, editing an old
  entry without a type, frozen/voter behaviour), Compose screen tests for the dialog, rows
  (badge, sub-line, "+" on income, my-effect colours), Balances (net line, income line, settled
  figure), Overview card, Reimburse -> Transfer, one-member list cannot pick Transfer. Follow the
  Robolectric pitfalls in AGENTS.md. Each new test must fail when its change is reverted.
title: Ledger Android: entry types, dialog, rows, balances, Ledger wording
